prioritized_issues.title: Recent activity device link still lands on an unscoped topology route
prioritized_issues.action: Click the recent activity device item HT075-DeviceLive-Z from the dashboard
prioritized_issues.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Sign in as admin and open /. 2. In Recent Activity, click the device item HT075-DeviceLive-Z. 3. Observe the resulting route and destination context.
prioritized_issues.expected_behavior: The device item should land on a concrete intended resource per the HT-082 ruling: /topology?workspace_id=<workspace_id>&topology_id=<topology_id>&device_id=<device_id> when a qualifying current published placement exists in scope, otherwise /inventory/edit/<device_id>.
prioritized_issues.actual_behavior: The app lands on /topology?device_id=7b3669ae-5a69-42bb-8322-429e7f6c0bf6, which opens a device panel but drops workspace/topology context and does not use the inventory edit fallback route.
